propositions: a child closed with disposition class (duplicate/not_a_bug/escalated) receives no completion-verifier attestation by design, but child_closure_findings requires one for all closed children, withholding the parent's certification

the close gate exempts dispositions from completion verification via a dedicated branch in transition_close.py, but the certification path ignores this exemption and treats unsigned closure as uncertified
an honestly-linked duplicate cannot earn certification without either deleting its replacement link or misrepresenting its close class, leaving no non-force remedy

the docstring of _completion_precheck omits the disposition branch as a third None-return path, causing child_closure_findings to misinterpret unsigned closures as unsigned-by-force rather than by exemption
a disposition close should return a signed attestation with manifest DISPOSITION <class> + replacement id rather than None, allowing certification to forward through the replacement link
the fix places force-close guard before the disposition branch so --force-close still withholds signature, preventing bypass of verification requirements
